svg.title: Pressure at a defined observer and finite acoustic arrivals
svg.desc: Bubble wall pressure pB is not pressure pprime at a remote sensor. Each source volume Vi has retarded travel distance di and activation delay ti. Density rho and sound speed c set monopole radiation and wave transit.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pressure needs a location and an observation time

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 压力必须指定位置与观测时刻
